h1: Hedgers roll up into the bounce
sub: Stocks bounced Monday morning, and the 10/30 protection wasn't dropped. It was moved up closer to the price in SPY, added to in QQQ, and started fresh in IWM.
tiles: net 10/30 delta, all six: mildly bearish

read: Read: a managed hedge, not a fresh bearish bet. The SPY hedger moved its 10/30 spread up from 750/735 to 760/745, the same move it made on 10/15, keeping protection close to the price into the late-October window.
